# Original P5 pending-model fixtures

Source: `0b5ec6e3bdd508e96cb52732b3d4dad863e8ada8` (parent of P6).

These records were generated by executing the **P5** `PipelineRuntime::admit`
in an isolated `git archive` of that commit, compiled with its own target
directory. No current writer generated these records. No provider executed.

The generator admitted two fixed run IDs ending in 501 (text) and 502 (image
reference), using `PipelineStart::text`, input `P5 fixture input`, model
`p5-pinned-model`, and output limit 77. The image was stored by the old
FilesystemBlobStore with bytes `p5-input`, MIME `image/png`, name `p5.png`, and
creation time 1. The old attachment struct had no `size_bytes` field.

`pending.sql` is Python sqlite3 `iterdump()` of the original database, with
its original `PRAGMA user_version = 5` retained explicitly (iterdump omits
that pragma). It contains the original snapshots, ledger JSON, reducer state,
events, schema versions and fixed admission digests.

`pending.json` contains the original starts, decoded records/snapshots and
exact UTF-8 contents and metadata of the original BlobStore objects, including
the model request artifacts. All content is synthetic and local.

The test restores the SQL and blobs directly **before** opening current stores.
It reads the old digest, replays without rewriting admission, executes the
pending artifact with an in-process fake model, and rejects changed attachment
identities. Do not regenerate these fixtures with the current writer.
